frozen_config.path_redaction_note: Public archive: dataset path and input_path values use data/initial/<name>; the compiler InstalledDir line was removed. manifest_sha256 and original_manifest_sha256 identify the original private-path manifest frozen before measurement. published_manifest_sha256 identifies the separately serialized public manifest in manifests/initial-v2.json.
